report_name: London Police Apologize for Data Breach in Mohamed Al-Fayed Investigation

identities.name: London Metropolitan Police Service
identities.description: The UK police force that inadvertently caused a data breach by failing to use the BCC function in an email to complainants in a sexual abuse investigation.

identities.name: Mohamed Al-Fayed
identities.description: The late businessman who was the subject of the sexual abuse investigation related to the data breach.

identities.name: Complainants in Mohamed Al-Fayed investigation
identities.description: A group of approximately 140 women whose email addresses were exposed in a data breach by the London Metropolitan Police.
